title: The Contact of Geneva
author: Gideon Thornbury
blurb: Casper Amberdale, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
